android.desc:
On the home page you can add, view and tap habit to log your day. You can login to sync the data using your Google account with Google Drive. You can also do this without an internet connection, our app supports offline mode.

Key Features:
- Android widgets 🤖
- Daily target habit 🎯
- Offline and sync mode 🛜
- Reminders 🔔
- Light and dark theme 📱
- Reorder Habits 😎
- Many more are coming. see https://habittool.pages.dev/roadmap !!!

A good way to start your log is usually:
- Meditating 🧘
- Eat Healthy 🥦
- Workout 🏋️
- Walking🚶 
- TIL (Today I learn) 📚

Of course you can always come up with something you want 😎

show_hn.title: Show HN: Habit Tool, a habit tracker app using Google Drive as a storage

quotes.text:
I built my habit tool app using Google Drive (app-spesific directory), it can sync between device, though it has a bug (in my code) sometimes cannot sync some data so I have to resync everything from scratch. No server needed.

Currently android only, don't have ios dev subscription https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yedev.habittrackertool

Looks good. How do you "done" past days? Sometimes I don't actually miss the habit but not have the time to open screen.

I also created similar habit tracker app for mobile https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yedev.habittrackertool The unique thing is that I use google drive to sync habits
quotes.story_title: Show HN: A free minimalist daily habit tracker

quotes.text:
It's a habit tracker app with fairly simple features where user log everyday habit, built with Flutter. Syncing to Google Drive incrementally using timestamp last synced data with offline-first mode. It uses Google Drive application-spesific data so the app can only access this app directory only and can't access your other data.

Currently Android only, I don't have iOS dev subscription.

Thanks...
